import BaseHTTPServer
import json
import time

INVENTORY = {"widgets": 42, "gadgets": 17, "gizmos": 5}
START = time.time()

class Handler(BaseHTTPServer.BaseHTTPRequestHandler):
    def do_GET(self):
        if self.path == "/health":
            body = json.dumps({"status": "ok", "uptime": time.time() - START})
        else:
            body = json.dumps(INVENTORY)
        self.send_response(200)
        self.send_header("Content-Type", "application/json")
        self.end_headers()
        self.wfile.write(body)

    def log_message(self, fmt, *args):
        pass

if __name__ == "__main__":
    server = BaseHTTPServer.HTTPServer(("0.0.0.0", 8080), Handler)
    server.serve_forever()

import time
import sys

chunk_size = 50 * 1024 * 1024  # 50MB
blocks = []
total = 0
while True:
    try:
        blocks.append(bytearray(chunk_size))
        total += chunk_size
        sys.stdout.write("allocated_mb=%d\n" % (total / (1024*1024)))
        sys.stdout.flush()
    except MemoryError:
        sys.stdout.write("MemoryError at total_mb=%d\n" % (total / (1024*1024)))
        sys.stdout.flush()
        time.sleep(1)
    time.sleep(0.3)
